title: TIC monthly release (April 2027 data) + the quarterly nonfinancial/derivatives cut — the first of the three editions FT-tic-monthly-2027-03-18-2 is waiting on
source: EST: home.treasury.gov/data/treasury-international-capital-tic-system/release-dates-of-tic-data, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (plain curl, HTTP 200, 111,194 bytes) by the tic-monthly-2027-05-18 initial research — its 2027 table's June row reads '16' in the Monthly column AND '16' in the 'Quarterly: data on nonfinancial firms, derivatives, portfolio claims and liabilities at end of previous quarter' column, with '30' standing in the SEPARATE 'Quarterly: U.S. gross external debt' column (a distinct release, already tracked as tic-quarterly-external-debt-2027-06-30). So this is a DOUBLE-cut release on 06-16, not a triple. Reference month April 2027 by the page's own 'end of month before last' rule. Corroborated mechanically: the 11th business day of June 2027 is 2027-06-15 (Tuesday), putting the published 2027-06-16 at +1 business day, inside the page's window; June 2027 carries no 5 U.S.C. 6103 federal holiday before the 11th business day (Juneteenth falls 06-18), so the date discriminates nothing between the holiday-aware and holiday-blind readings of the rule. Filed estimate per this lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep: the proposer may not confirm what it found, only the event's own session may. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: DISCOVERED during the tic-monthly-2027-05-18 initial research (2026-09-09), the next unclaimed monthly slot after 2027-05-18. IT IS THE FIRST SCORING OBSERVATION FOR AN ALREADY-REGISTERED SIBLING TEST. FT-tic-monthly-2027-03-18-2 names '2027-06-16, 2027-09-16 or 2027-12-16' explicitly and scores on the first of the three a session actually measures — its question is whether the quarterly-cut structure is a revision mechanism that was only ever looked for in March. This is that first one. IT ALSO CARRIES A JOB THE MAY EDITION CANNOT DO. The proposer's own ledger found that adding a non-Feb/Mar ordinary observation to FT-tic-monthly-2027-01-19-3's panel buys a likelihood ratio of only about 1.3:1 in the likely branch — roughly nine such observations to move a 50/50 prior to 90/10 — because a new control vintage enters BOTH readings' control group. A quarterly-cut vintage is different: it is the one ordinary sub-class with a named alternative mechanism attached, so it discriminates where a pure control merely accumulates. CORRIDOR, measured on the same computation the sibling used: 2027-06-16 is a Wednesday; the scored session 2027-06-17 is a Thursday carrying opex-2027-06-17, and juneteenth-market-closure-2027-06-18 shuts the following session. The FOMC decision fomc-2027-06-09 stands SEVEN days before the release and fomc-minutes-2027-06-30 fourteen days after, so unlike May the scored session carries no Fed communication - but it does sit one session before a federal holiday closure, which is its own contaminant and is stated rather than smoothed. Impact LOW and symbols empty on the standing grounds (16:00 ET publication after the cash close, six-week-stale data, no macro-keyed house playbook). Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
